name: SciFact: Scientific Claim Verification Benchmark
description: SciFact is a dataset for verifying scientific claims using evidence from scientific literature. It consists of 1,409 expert-written claims paired with evidence rationale sentences and label judgements (SUPPORT, CONTRADICT, NO_INFO) extracted from 5,183 research abstracts.
